method: Bounded independent exact-file real-browser runtime measurement and selected actual pixel inspection; scope below. Not whole-candidate acceptance.
scope: Measured Apple M5 Pro/ANGLE Metal runtime; software correctness and software budget failure are reported separately.

runtime.device: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M5 Pro, Unspecified Version)
runtime.rendered_frames_scope: Count of captured 24 orbit renders, excluding other diagnostics

warnings: Fine opaque double-sided needle geometry can show ordinary subpixel edge aliasing during orbit; stationary draws were byte-stable.
SwiftShader 16/32-copy frame budget fails; this is software and is not hidden by the Metal pass.
observations: Exact GLB hash and normalized Int16Array NORMAL attributes verified in the browser.
No alpha-blended foliage: opacity 1, transparent false; foliage materials use DoubleSide.
Source and current website renderer/preset hashes, actual images, camera/light/resolution, raw samples and query disjoint flags are preserved.
Minor r19/r20 pixel differences are nonzero and available for independent artistic review.

warning_review.rationale: Harness imports compiled website Three.js for ModelStage and a second same-version 0.180.0 module for the separate grove after disposing ModelStage. This is a probe-only warning, not deployed application behavior.

test_conditions_limitations: One owned isolated browser at a time, fixed DPR1 and viewport, 20 warmup renders, 60 elapsed-query samples, 30 rAF intervals.
Unrelated host workload, thermal state and long-duration power behavior were not controlled or measured; results are scoped to this run.
